description: Read one French judicial decision by id (from fr_judilibre_search): full pseudonymised text, its structural zones (introduction/exposé/moyens/motivations/dispositif/annexes as character offsets into `text`), the texts it applies (`visa`, with best-effort `cited_articles` linking to @pipeworx/france-legi's code+article), related decisions (contested, forward, rapprochements) and attached files.

id.description: The decision id, from a fr_judilibre_search result.

resolve_references.description: When true, the source resolves linked decision/text references inline instead of leaving them as bare ids (default false).

name: fr_judilibre_decision
title: Fr Judilibre Decision
